messages:
Anya: Quick QBR heads-up for Acme — they want clear token econ + a 90-day spend forecast. Also: renewal conversation flags if cost/latency don't improve. Can folks share the numbers and 3 tangible ops recommendations by Tue EOD?
Miguel: On it. I'll pull model-by-model RPTs and a heatmap. Need 30d token distribution + prefix cache hit rate from the runtime logs.
Shannon: FYI finance flagged Acme's monthly committed spend is near trigger for billing review. I can share forecasted burn and variance to commit.
Miguel: Paste of quick sketch (from runtime):
```
model     avg_tok / req   perf_cost $/k Tok   cache_hit %
redwood-7b  120            0.78                  18%
redwood-13b 230            1.60                  12%
redwood-30b 410            3.40                   7%
```
Miguel: Early takeaways: 1) heavy tail of long-context requests on 30b — recommend quantized 30b variant or route >512 to 13b with re-ranking. 2) Enable prefix KV caching for their chat flows (estimated 15-25% token reduction). 3) Suggest 5% burst capacity switch to Dedicated during peak for latency SLOs.
Kai: For enablement — I can run a 45m session with their eng team to go over batching, cache knobs, and prompt edits. Proposed slot Wed 10am PT.
Anya: Great. Shannon — can you confirm the forecast numbers and a potential delta to mention in renewal (e.g., projected +12% vs commit)?
Shannon: Confirmed draft: next 90d projected spend $142k, commit level $125k, variance +13.6%. I'll attach a slide with monthly breakout after I sync with billing.
billing-bot: automated alert: customer Acme corp (acct_id: acme-001) projected month-end spend $52,800 exceeds alert threshold $50,000. Latest invoice link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/acme-001/2026-02
Anya: Action items: Miguel — deliver heatmap + 2 slide TL;DR of ops changes. Shannon — final forecast + one-line renewal risk. Kai — enablement invite + short QA doc. I'll stitch into a single QBR slide deck.
Miguel: Will deliver heatmap JSON + 2 slides by Tue 3pm PT.
Shannon: Sending forecast slide by Tue 2pm PT.
Kai: Confirmed Wed 10am PT for enablement, will include a short checklist: batching, cache TTLs, routing policies.
Anya: Thanks team — if we can quantify expected token savings per recommendation that will make the renewal conversation much cleaner. I'll draft the customer-facing summary after we have the numbers. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: QBR prep for Acme: collect token economics, 90-day spend forecast, alerts, and enablement; assign Miguel for heatmap and recommendations, Shannon for finance forecast, Kai for enablement, billing-bot reported spend alert.
